title.en: Residents watch and bring water and food

summary.zh: UPI 報導 22 日「工人和家庭再次湧向廣場，多數是圍觀者，有些人加入悼念、支持學生」；二手整理提到天亮後越來越多市民加入。具體誰送了什麼，屬於一般性證言；遊戲中的送水大媽、大爺都是虛構人物。
summary.en: UPI reported workers and families flocking to the Square, some supporting the students. Specific acts of giving water/food here are fictional, modelled on general testimony.

sources.title: Hu Yaobang's Funeral (excerpts NYT 1989-04-22 + reconstruction)
sources.publisher: Standoff at Tiananmen (Eddie Cheng), 2008 — secondary account
